tips.text: Aim Dredge Line at a wall near the enemy when ganking or when no target is in range; if it hits terrain you pull yourself over and get some cooldown back.
Throw Dredge Line only when the line is clear. It stops on the first enemy it hits, so a minion in the way blocks it.
Land Dredge Line, then use Staggering Blow on the stunned target so they are rooted again as the stun ends.
Cast Riptide when enemies step in close, or while retreating. The waves land late, so it works as a deterrent and slows them.
Turn on Titan's Wrath before you swing in a fight. While the shield holds, your attacks also hurt enemies standing near your target.
Save Depth Charge for a key enemy, such as the carry. It chases them and knocks up and stuns everyone it passes through, so aim your path through their team.
Your ultimate won't stop for a dead target, but a spell shield can block it. Wait for the shield to be used before casting it.

combos.name: Terrain Dredge Line into Riptide
combos.when: When ganking or closing in on a target, or engaging from a bush, and you want a more reliable engage.
combos.text: Aim the anchor at nearby terrain so you dash to it for half the cooldown back, then use the slow when you land. Riot suggests this to raise your hit rate.

tips.text: Aim Dredge Line at Alistar when he is away from his allies. He is a tough target, so hook his damage dealer when you can.
If Alistar uses Unbreakable Will, back off and wait. It cleanses stuns and cuts his damage taken, so don't use Depth Charge on him then.
Stay out of the range of Alistar's Headbutt and Pulverize combo, especially near turrets. Keep your distance until Headbutt is on cooldown.
Use Riptide when Alistar steps in to slow him and cut his engage. His Trample needs him close to enemies, so slowing him cuts his stacks.
Hit Dredge Line on Anivia when she steps forward to cast. You get a stun and can reach her to use Staggering Blow.
Hold back when Flash Frost comes at you, then dodge sideways. Standing in a lane with minions makes it harder to dodge.
Watch for Crystallize between you; it blocks your path, so go around or aim Dredge Line elsewhere.
Use Depth Charge on Anivia at level 6 to kill her; she can't act in her egg, so finish the egg too.
Use Riptide when she is close to slow her and make her trade poorly.
Throw Dredge Line at Bard when he steps up to collect a chime or walks near a wall. A hit stuns him and pulls you both together.
Walk over Bard's shrines to destroy them before his ally can take the heal.
Aim Dredge Line at a wall to close distance fast when Bard slips away through a portal.
Use Depth Charge on Bard when he is in your team's kill zone. Spell shields aside, he has no way to dodge it once it is fired.
Hit Bard with the first attack after Titan's Wrath or Dredge Line; Staggering Blow roots him briefly.
Aim Dredge Line at Blitzcrank only when no minion is between you. The anchor stops on the first enemy it hits.
Stay behind minions so Rocket Grab hits one of them first. It only pulls the first enemy it meets.
Take Titan's Wrath into a trade. Its shield soaks damage and your attacks hurt Blitzcrank and anyone near him.
Watch Blitzcrank's health. When he drops low, Mana Barrier shields him, so wait out the shield before you go for the kill.
Use Riptide to slow Blitzcrank when he runs in with Overdrive. That blunts his speed burst.
Hook Brand with Dredge Line whenever he steps forward to poke. He has no escape, and you can pull him into your team.
Dodging Sear and Pillar of Flame stops his combo. Sidestep them before you walk up.
Keep minions out of the line to Brand, because Dredge Line stops at the first enemy. Aim it at a wall to close distance when no clean line exists.
Use Titan's Wrath before you walk into his range. The shield soaks his burst while you close in.
Stay away from your own allies when Pyroclasm comes out. It is slow at first, so you can step apart.
Use Depth Charge on Brand when he is ablaze and out of position. He cannot dodge it once it is chasing him.
Wait for Braum's Unbreakable to end before you throw Dredge Line. It destroys missiles coming from the direction he faces.
Braum's Winter's Bite slows you and starts his stun marks. Stay out of its line, and do not fight right after it hits you.
Hit Braum with Staggering Blow first when you reach him. It roots him briefly, so your team can hit him before he gets away.
Use Titan's Wrath before you trade in melee. The shield lets your attacks damage Braum and any enemies near him.
Use Riptide when Braum and his ally are close to you. It slows them and punishes them for staying in a fight.
Save Depth Charge for when Braum's ally is the carry. Its stun lets your team kill them, even if Braum is behind a raised shield.
Aim Dredge Line at Camille when she is off a wall or away from her minions; the anchor stops on the first enemy it hits, so keep a minion out of its path.
Use Depth Charge on Camille's target when she dives in, so she is knocked up and stunned before she can finish her combo.
Cast Titan's Wrath before you trade. The shield soaks her hits, and your attacks then hurt her and anyone next to her.
Use Riptide when Camille swings in to slow her. Her Tactical Sweep is slow to land, so step out of the cone while she winds up.
Keep your first attack for Camille. Staggering Blow roots her briefly, which sets up your follow-up.
Aim Dredge Line at Janna when she steps forward to poke. Being pulled in stuns her, and she has little to escape with.
Do not rush at Janna while Monsoon is ready. It knocks you back and heals her team.
Make Janna use Howling Gale first, then go in. It has a long cooldown and its charge-up is audible.
Harass Janna's ally. She is strongest buffing a teammate, so pressuring them weakens her.
Use Depth Charge on a target Janna has shielded only after the shield is gone. The stun still lands, but the shield absorbs the damage.
Throw Dredge Line at Karma when she steps up to poke. Pull her in and follow with Staggering Blow.
Stand behind minions when Karma aims Inner Flame, because it stops at the first unit it hits.
Move out of range when Karma tethers you with Focused Resolve. Breaking it avoids the root.
Activate Titan's Wrath before you close in. The shield soaks her poke and your attacks hit her whole team.
Use Riptide when Karma stands close to slow her. She is easier to catch with Depth Charge.
Aim Dredge Line at Leona when she steps up for a Zenith Blade; it stops on the first enemy it hits, so hook her before her minions get in the way.
Use Riptide when Leona dashes in; it slows her and punishes her for committing.
Move out of the center of Solar Flare quickly; only the middle stuns you.
Back away when Leona raises Eclipse instead of trading into it, then come back once it ends.
Aim Dredge Line at Lulu, not her marksman. She is the one who can polymorph you, so pulling her in puts you next to the enemy who can lock you down.
Stay behind your minions so Pix's bolts get blocked and Glitterlance has less room to reach you.
Once Lulu is dragged in, hit her with your first attack so Staggering Blow roots her, then follow with Riptide.
Save Depth Charge for when Lulu uses Wild Growth on her carry. It chases your target and knocks up everyone it passes through.
Turn on Titan's Wrath before you walk up to trade. The shield soaks poke and your attacks then hit everyone near your target.
Aim Dredge Line at Lux when she steps forward to poke. She is fragile, and being pulled in lets you hit her with Staggering Blow.
Walk through the wave with minions in front of you carefully. Light Binding roots the first two enemies it hits, so do not stand in a line with your ADC.
Dodge to the side when you see the red line of Final Spark. Avoid standing in line with allies when you retreat.
Activate Titan's Wrath before trading. The shield soaks Lux's poke and your attacks then hit her and nearby enemies.
Use Riptide as you step through Lucent Singularity to close in. It slows her, so she cannot kite away.
Aim Dredge Line at Maokai only when no minion is in the way; the anchor stops at the first unit it hits.
Do not waste spells hitting Maokai during Twisted Advance; he is untargetable while dashing.
Do not spam Riptide into Maokai; every spell that hits him shortens the cooldown on his self-heal.
Walk around Sapling Toss, especially ones in brush, as they chase you and hurt more.
Hold Titan's Wrath until you are about to fight; the shield and extra damage on your attacks last only a short time.
Wait until Mel has used Rebuttal before you throw Dredge Line. Her nova destroys enemy projectiles, so a hook thrown into it is wasted.
Hook Mel when she steps up to poke, then follow with Depth Charge or your first attack. She has no way to get out once you are on her.
Stay out of a long Solar Snare. It roots longer the farther the orb has flown, so keep close or step out of its line.
When you walk up, switch on Titan's Wrath first. The shield soaks her poke and your attacks then hit her for extra damage.
Back off when you are low. Her attacks and spells stack Overwhelm, and enough stored damage executes you.
Use Riptide when you are close to her. It slows her so you can catch her and land your first attack.
Aim Dredge Line at Milio when he is away from his ADC; he has no easy way out once you pull him in.
Follow a hit from Dredge Line with your first attack; Staggering Blow roots him in place.
Wait for Milio to use Ultra Mega Fire Kick, then step in and hook him. It is his main way to poke you away.
Use Depth Charge on Milio when his ally is close to him; it also hits anyone caught along its path.
Activate Titan's Wrath before you walk into the enemy duo, so your attacks hit both of them.
Aim Dredge Line at Morgana whenever she steps up to poke; she has no dash, so a hit is hard for her to dodge.
Stay behind minions to block Dark Binding, since it stops at the first enemy it hits.
Wait until Black Shield is used, then go in. While it holds, Morgana is not stunned or rooted by you.
Riptide is magic damage and can break Black Shield, so use it on a shielded Morgana before you engage.
Step out of Tormented Shadow quickly; staying in while hurt makes it hit much harder.
Aim Dredge Line at Nami as soon as she steps up to cast; if it hits, she is stunned and dragged to you, so finish her with Staggering Blow and Riptide.
Aqua Prison lands after a short delay, so keep moving sideways when Nami throws it. Dodging it leaves her open to your engage.
Aim Dredge Line at a wall if Nami is out of range or you need to move in safely. It also refunds part of its cooldown.
Use Titan's Wrath before you trade in melee range. The shield soaks her poke and your attacks hit her and her carry together.
Tidal Wave is slow and easy to see coming, so step out of its path rather than wasting a spell on it.
Aim Dredge Line at Neeko when she steps up. The stun is brief, so follow it with Depth Charge or a Staggering Blow attack to kill her.
Stay out of a straight line with Neeko when you can. If a minion stands between you, Dredge Line stops on it and Tangle-Barbs gets stronger.
Use Titan's Wrath before you trade. The shield soaks her poke, and your attacks then hurt her and anyone next to her.
Do not trust a lone ally champion or minion that walks oddly near you. It may be Neeko disguised, so check before you commit.
Use Riptide when Neeko dives in or tries to run. It damages her and leaves her slowed.
Aim Dredge Line only when Pantheon is not bracing Aegis Assault toward you; it blocks damage from the front, so wait it out.
Use Riptide as soon as Pantheon jumps in with Shield Vault; it slows him and punishes his dive.
Stay healthy when Pantheon has a spear ready. A thrown Comet Spear hits much harder against low-health targets.
Watch his Mortal Will counter. When it is full, his next spell is empowered, so back off from that fight.
Get Titan's Wrath up before you trade. With the shield on, your attacks also damage the enemies near your target.
Move away from the marked area when Grand Starfall lands, since it warns you ahead. Use Depth Charge on Pantheon when he lands.
Wait for Poppy to spend Steadfast Presence before you use Dredge Line. It can stop your dash.
Do not stand with a wall behind you near Poppy. Heroic Charge will stun you if it carries you into terrain.
Step on Poppy's buckler to destroy it and deny her shield.
Use Titan's Wrath before you trade. Your shield makes your attacks damage Poppy and nearby enemies.
Use Riptide when Poppy walks up to you. It slows her and punishes her for coming close.
Watch for Poppy's spinning hammer. She is charging Keeper's Verdict, so step out of line or stay away.
Aim Dredge Line at Pyke early; if it lands you drag him in and stun him. Pyke is fragile, so follow up with an attack to root him.
Chase Pyke when he is low, because he heals back what he lost once you cannot see him. Finish the trade before he hides.
Use Riptide when Pyke dashes or dives in close. It slows him and the waves hit more than once if he stays in them.
Turn on Titan's Wrath before you trade with attacks. Its shield absorbs some of Pyke's burst, and your attacks hit him and anyone nearby.
Save Depth Charge to stun Pyke if he lands a pull on your carry. It cannot be dodged once cast, so use it to punish him.
Aim Dredge Line at Rakan when he is away from his partner; the anchor stops at the first enemy it hits, so watch for minions in the way.
Look for Rakan alone, because with no ally nearby his Battle Dance has nowhere to go and he cannot escape easily.
Hit Rakan with Dredge Line and attack right away; Staggering Blow roots him briefly, so he cannot dash off.
Rakan's Grand Entrance shows where he will land. Step out of the area, or stun him with Depth Charge at level 6 before it goes off.
Use Riptide when you are about to be jumped on; the slow punishes Rakan for diving in.
Aim Dredge Line at Rell when she is mounted and walking up. Dragging her in sets up Staggering Blow and Riptide.
Stay out of Shattering Strike range when you have no shield to spare. It stuns, and it also destroys your Titan's Wrath shield.
Hold Depth Charge for when Rell is committed to a fight. Her Magnet Storm pulls in enemies, so it is best used with allies close by.
Use Riptide when Rell leaps in with Ferromancy: Crash Down. It slows her and punishes the dive.
Aim Dredge Line at Senna the moment she steps up to attack a minion; she has short-range escapes, so a hit means a long stun and a kill threat.
Senna out-ranges you, so don't walk up in the open. Use bushes and terrain, and aim Dredge Line at a wall if she is too far away.
Her Last Embrace roots you after a short delay. Move out of its path, or save Titan's Wrath to soak the damage when you are caught.
Once Dredge Line pulls you in, hit Senna with a basic attack to root her with Staggering Blow, then use Riptide so she can't walk away.
Hold Depth Charge for Senna or her carry; the stun is long, and it hits others in its path too.
Aim Dredge Line at Seraphine, not her ally. She has no escape, so a hit usually means a kill when your carry follows up.
Hit Seraphine with Dredge Line, then use Depth Charge on her while she is stunned. Stay on her and she cannot easily get away.
Her Beat Drop is a straight line that she must aim. Strafe sideways or stand behind a minion before you walk up, and you will dodge most of it.
Cast Titan's Wrath before you trade. The shield soaks her poke, and your attacks then hurt her and any enemy next to her.
Use Riptide when you run in to slow both enemies. Stay close, as it makes them easier to catch and hit.
Do not stand in a clump with your carry when she has Encore up. It charms everyone it hits and extends across champions.
Aim Dredge Line at Shen when he steps up to poke; he must walk to you, so his Twilight Assault range is short.
Do not attack into Spirit's Refuge; your basic attacks are blocked. Wait for it to end, then go in.
Stay out of Shen's Shadow Dash line; being taunted makes you walk toward him and take damage.
Use Riptide when Shen dashes at you or walks close; it slows him and hits him as he arrives.
Watch for Shen's level 6 Stand United; if he starts channeling, finish off your target before he teleports in.
Aim Dredge Line at Sona when she steps up to poke; she is fragile and dies fast once caught.
Hit minions out of the line first or angle around them, because Dredge Line stops at the first enemy it touches.
Dodge Crescendo by not standing grouped up with your team; spread out so it cannot stun all of you.
Use Titan's Wrath for the shield before you trade with Sona's poke, then attack to deal extra damage.
After you land Dredge Line on Sona, follow up with Staggering Blow and Riptide to keep her from getting away.
Aim Dredge Line at Soraka when she steps up to cast Starcall; she is fragile and the stun lets your team kill her.
Do not stand in Equinox. Walk out before it ends, or you will be rooted and hit again.
When Soraka uses Equinox, it is on a long cooldown; that is your moment to engage.
Use Titan's Wrath before you walk up, then attack. The shield soaks poke and your hits damage everyone near.
Go for Soraka with Depth Charge at level 6; healing will not save her from the stun.
Aim Dredge Line at Swain whenever he steps forward to poke or throw Nevermove. The stun leaves him unable to dodge your follow-up.
Stay behind minions so Death's Hand and Nevermove have a harder time reaching you.
Move sideways away from Vision of Empire's circle once you see it appear; it takes a moment to explode.
Take a shield with Titan's Wrath before you walk up, then attack him so he takes damage over time.
Don't use Riptide until Swain's Nevermove has rooted you and you're already too close to escape.
Swain heals while Demonic Ascension drains you, so avoid fighting him when he's transformed; slow him with Riptide and walk away.
Aim Dredge Line at Tahm Kench's allies or at him early; the anchor stops at the first enemy it hits, so minions in the way block it.
Follow a Dredge Line hit with Staggering Blow on the stunned target, then use Riptide to keep them slowed while you trade.
Trade when Tahm Kench has just taken damage; his Thick Skin only heals after a few quiet seconds, so keep pressure on him.
Move out of the way when Abyssal Dive shows its landing spot; Depth Charge or Dredge Line on him while he channels can interrupt it.
Avoid taking three hits from Tahm Kench in a row; at three stacks of An Acquired Taste his Tongue Lash stuns you or he can use Devour on you.
Dredge Line is your best tool. Use it on Taric when his Dazzle is on cooldown, or on his carry when they stand apart from him.
Step out of the way of Dazzle as it winds up. You can still move during it, and the beam only bursts after a delay.
Hit Taric's carry when Bastion's tether is stretched. Cosmic Radiance has a long delay, so kill someone before it lands or back off.
Hit Taric when he walks up to attack. Each attack he lands with Bravado cuts his cooldowns.
Activate Titan's Wrath before you trade. While the shield holds, your attacks hit Taric and everyone near him.
Throw Dredge Line at Thresh when he steps up to hook; if the anchor hits terrain it still drags you, and it is a safe way to reposition.
Watch for Thresh's Death Sentence cast to begin and step out of its line, because it takes a moment to throw.
If Thresh uses Flay next to you, stand still until Riptide-style waves end; here, simply avoid running into his follow-up and keep your distance.
Turn on Titan's Wrath before you trade; the shield soaks poke and your attacks then hit him and his ally.
Use Riptide when you are close to the enemies; it slows them, so you can follow with an attack that roots them.
At level 6, use Depth Charge on the enemy carry to lock them down; it knocks up and stuns anyone caught in its path.
Aim Dredge Line at Vel'Koz as soon as he steps up to poke; it drags you onto him and stuns him, and he has little to escape with.
Use Depth Charge on Vel'Koz when he starts channeling his ray; the knock up and stun interrupt it.
Hit Vel'Koz with your first attack after you land on him; Staggering Blow roots him in place for your follow-up.
Cast Titan's Wrath before you walk into Vel'Koz range; the shield soaks some of his poke and makes your attacks hit harder.
Stay out of a straight line with Vel'Koz, because Dredge Line stops at the first enemy it hits. Keep minions out of the path or you will waste it.
After you close in, use Riptide so he is slowed and cannot easily walk out of your reach.
Xerath is weak up close, so go for Dredge Line when he stands still to poke, then follow with attacks.
Wait for Xerath to use Shocking Orb before you step up. Dodge it, because the stun gets longer the farther it travels.
Fire Riptide as you close in to slow Xerath so he cannot step away.
Turn on Titan's Wrath before you hit Xerath; the shield blunts his poke and your hits damage him over time.
Land your first attack on Xerath to root him with Staggering Blow, then keep hitting him.
Look for a chance to use Depth Charge on Xerath once he has used his Shocking Orb.
Aim Dredge Line at Yuumi's ally when she is attached; she can't be targeted, so the anchor goes for the champion she rides.
When Yuumi is not attached, hook her first with Dredge Line. She is fragile and has little to escape with.
Follow a hook with Staggering Blow on the first attack so the target is rooted and can't walk away.
Use Riptide when the enemy pair stands close together; it slows both and deals damage to each.
Save Depth Charge for a kill; the enemy champion it chases is stunned, and it also hits others in its path.
Aim Dredge Line at Zilean when he steps up to throw bombs. He is fragile, and the stun lets your team kill him.
Don't stand in a clump after Zilean puts a Time Bomb on you. A second bomb will stun you and anyone beside you.
If Zilean uses Chronoshift, wait it out before the kill. The ally returns after a short time, so don't waste Depth Charge on them.
Use Riptide to hit Zilean and his carry together. It slows them, and you can then close in.
Aim Dredge Line at Zyra when she steps up to plant; she is fragile, and the stun gives you time to reach her.
Step on her seeds to destroy them before she grows them into plants, but expect to be revealed for a moment.
Use Riptide when plants and Zyra are close to you; it damages them and leaves enemies slowed.
Activate Titan's Wrath before you hit Zyra so your attack also damages her nearby plants.
Use Depth Charge on Zyra once she is committed; the enemy can't cast while stunned.
